title: Rust parity: Rust Priority enum missing SOS and NORMAL levels
description: Python has 5 Priority levels (SOS=0, ROUTING=1, URGENT=2, NORMAL=3, BULK=4). Rust TxPriority only has 4 (Control=0, Routing=1, User=2, Bulk=3). Missing SOS emergency level and NORMAL/BULK distinction. Fix: align TxPriority with spec and Python.
close_reason: Fixed: Added SOS and NORMAL priority levels to Rust TxPriority enum for Python parity. Updated enum from 4 to 5 levels (Sos/Routing/Urgent/Normal/Bulk mapping to P0-P4), updated deadline constants, and fixed all dependent code in lichen-core, lichen-tui, and lichen-gateway.
